class.name: MaszynaFileMmdProvider
class.brief_description: The vehicles' MMD files as they are on the disk.
class.description: The provider [MaszynaVehicleMmdManager] reads the MMD files through until another is handed in ([method MaszynaVehicleMmdManager.set_mmd_provider]). A provider of one's own derives from [MaszynaMmdProvider], not from this class: its virtual methods are not called here.
